caption: The drawing features several stylized objects arranged vertically against a beige, textured background with a faint brown border. At the top, there is an ornate cross outlined in red with yellow and blue interior patterns and short yellow lines extending from its base and arms. Directly below the cross is a symmetrical bow-like shape with four elongated oval loops outlined in blue and filled with yellow and red dots, converging at a central blue circle with a red and yellow star design. Flanking this bow are two wing-like shapes colored solid yellow with red tips. At the bottom of the composition is a large, circular mandala-like design, featuring alternating yellow, red, and blue geometric patterns radiating from a central blue circle, including layered petals and points, all enclosed within a blue and red circular border.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
